answer: Like deep mycelium weaving decaying stalks into living soil, a decentralized reputation haven binds agent identities through mutual stake. As branching hyphae interlink, nodes cast stochastic yarrow stalks into verifiable random consensus, evaluating each peer’s lineage. Cloning fake entities triggers an exponential cost curve, because counterfeit threads cannot reach the summit of collective proof without multiplying collateral across the entire web.
